headline: Binance Replaces CFO Following Security Breach
summary: Binance has replaced its Chief Financial Officer, Kaiser Ng, after more than five years in the role, following a USD 6.3 billion hack. The company stated the departure was planned.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and management changes following major security incidents are closely watched by digital asset markets.
